notes: This contract pins Umbra's bounded IEEE 1516.1-2025 timestamped Send Interaction and timestamped Receive Interaction C++ surfaces to the official declarations exported by the Requirements Lab. It covers the non-regional logical-time overload, federation-owned queueing for constrained recipients, callback-before-grant ordering, official timestamp/order/retraction fields, and the default-source/default-region FQR/TARA/NMRA companion with supplied-empty region metadata. Regional Send Interaction With Regions, directed interaction, deletion, broader alternate advances, remote transport, save/restore, package/JUnit/protected-review evidence, and conformance remain separate scope.
